reddog.description:
Develop and maintain the company's internal POS system: an outlet app, a CMS, and a client app (React JS and React Native) backed by a Go (Gin) API.
Fix bugs across the UI, API, and database layers in the transaction, inventory, client, outlet, and CMS modules.
Implement MVP features end to end, from Gin endpoints to integration in the outlet and CMS apps, extending the legacy codebase within its existing workflows.

united_tractors.company_name: PT Global Service Indonesia, placed at PT United Tractors Tbk
united_tractors.description:
Built COIP Mobile, an offline-first field-inspection app for United Tractors' heavy-equipment customers, with Realm handling queued sync on reconnection (React Native 0.74 / Expo, TanStack Query, Zustand, NativeWind). It replaces a paper-based process and cuts customer inspection time by up to 30%.
Auto-generated the typed API layer from the backend's OpenAPI spec with Kubb, so TypeScript types, Zod schemas, and TanStack Query hooks stay in sync with the API.
Handled conditional validation across 100+ form fields in multi-tab checksheets with react-hook-form and Zod.
Added root and jailbreak detection, screenshot prevention, and encrypted local storage.
Wrote 100+ unit and UI tests in Jest and React Native Testing Library, and managed releases through Azure DevOps.

nexa.description:
Shipped six production apps across Flutter and React Native, owning each one end to end: UI implementation, Firebase integration (FCM, Crashlytics, Analytics), testing, and store release.
ForYou by Sinarmas Land: rated 4.8 on Google Play (370+ reviews, 10K+ downloads) and 4.8 on the App Store.
Also built MyKekancan, NMSxPro Mobile, Hebat!, Kla Computer (Infokom), and Nexa Ticket Scanner.

inkaedu.description:
Built a learning management system for AMDAL certification training: a rich-text course builder (Quill/TinyMCE), FullCalendar scheduling, practice exams, and Chart.js progress dashboards (React 18, Redux Toolkit, React Router).
Deployed the frontend and backend to production. 100+ registrants signed up at launch, replacing a manual registration process.

naratik.description:
Built a Kotlin batik e-commerce app for local SMEs with AI-powered authenticity checks, offline sync (Room, DataStore, WorkManager), and push notifications (Clean Architecture, MVVM, Hilt, Retrofit, Firebase).
Co-authored an IEEE paper on CNN-based batik authenticity classification, which provided the model behind the app's authenticity feature.

bangkit.company_name: Bangkit Academy led by Google, Tokopedia, Gojek & Traveloka
bangkit.description:
Selected for Google's Bangkit program, Android learning path (Kotlin, MVVM, dependency injection, SQLite).
The capstone project ranked Top 15 nationally and received incubation funding from Google and Kemendikbudristek.

udinus.description: Ran weekly object-oriented programming lab sessions for classes of up to 30 students, and mentored students through coursework in Java, PHP, and JavaScript.

reddog_application.description_project: Nx monorepo with the customer app, outlet staff app, and admin backoffice on one shared API and auth layer (React Native 0.87 bare, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router + Query, Nitro modules).

reddog_backend.description_project: Seven gRPC services behind a Gin REST gateway. Writes go through an outbox to Kafka, and reads come from Elasticsearch projections (PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenTelemetry).

pos_frontend.description_project: Flutter monorepo (Melos) with a web CMS for the shop owner and an offline-first cashier app that keeps selling while the internet is down, then syncs (BLoC, drift, Clean Architecture).

pos_backend.description_project: REST API for Shop POS: atomic sales, offline sync, debt tracking, Midtrans QRIS/VA payments, and PDF reports, with GORM/PostgreSQL, Redis, and Cobra CLI migrations on a Linux VPS.

coip.description_project: Offline-first field-inspection app for heavy-equipment customers: job creation, multi-tab checksheets, photo evidence, and Realm-queued sync. Cuts inspection time by up to 30%. Distributed internally.

foryou.description_project: Mall membership app with biometric login, QR coupon redemption, and receipt capture (Riverpod, Clean Architecture). Rated 4.8 on Google Play (10K+ downloads) and 4.8 on the App Store.

mykekancan.description_project: Membership app with QR point scanning, Google Maps merchant discovery, and multi-language support (Riverpod).

nmsxpro.description_project: Network-monitoring companion for field technicians with an on-device SSH client for remote operations on network equipment (BLoC).

hebat.description_project: Tax payment and monitoring app for the Semarang city government (Redux Toolkit).

nexa_ticket.description_project: Barcode and QR event ticket scanner for field operators.

kla_computer.description_project: Company information and monitoring dashboard with charts, real-time push notifications, and WebView integration (Redux Toolkit, FCM).

naratik.description_project: Batik e-commerce app for local SMEs with an AI authenticity checker, offline sync (Hilt, Room, WorkManager). The Play Store listing was removed after the company closed.

inkaedu_lms.description_project: Learning platform for AMDAL certification training: course builder, scheduling, practice exams, and progress dashboards. 100+ registrants at launch.

kmp_todo.description_project: Full-stack Kotlin: a Compose Multiplatform client that shares domain models with a Ktor backend, with JWT refresh tokens, BCrypt, Exposed, PostgreSQL, and Swagger.

local_ota.description_project: Lightweight Go server delivering React Native JS bundles and Module Federation chunks for Re.Pack v5, with API-key auth, Brotli/Gzip, and byte-range downloads.

batik_cnn.description_project: CNN with transfer learning to classify batik authenticity, published at the 2021 Sixth International Conference on Informatics and Computing (IEEE). Powers Naratik's authenticity checker.

cinebrowse.description_project: Movie browser with offline favorites, infinite scroll, and theme switching; UI, domain, and data layers with unit tests (Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, Paging 3, MockK).

tbp_maps.description_project: Map screen driven by a four-state machine for browsing public facility locations (React Native 0.81 New Architecture, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, Zod, MMKV).

expo_repack.description_project: Module Federation setup with one host app loading two mini apps and a shared module at runtime (Re.Pack, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo).

voip_demo.description_project: Voice calling over WebRTC with phone number and OTP sign-in and push notifications for incoming calls (Riverpod codegen, Firebase Auth, FCM, go_router).

qr_payment.description_project: Scans payment QR codes with the camera, records payments, and keeps a local history (Jetpack Compose, CameraX, ML Kit Barcode, Hilt, Room).

payment_app.description_project: Payment tracking app with Riverpod, dio, and workmanager background jobs.

boilerlib.description_project: Reusable Flutter starter: dio interceptors, route guards, camera, and permissions.

money_expense_tracker.description_project: Expense tracking app built to complete the IDCamp Flutter beginner class.

portfolio_web.description_project: This website: a Flutter Web portfolio backed by Cloud Firestore and Firebase Hosting.

rent_game.description_project: My first Jetpack Compose app, with Room and Coil.

semargress.description_project: Semarang Great Sale event app with a merchant feed and voucher claims for local MSMEs.

rn_maps.description_project: React Native app with Google Maps integration.

employee_crud.description_project: Employee management CRUD app with React Navigation and React Native Paper.

gameinfo.description_project: Game catalog split into a core module and a dynamic feature module for favorites, with CI on CircleCI (Flow, Hilt, Retrofit, Room).

movie_catalogue.description_project: Movie catalogue with Retrofit, Room, Paging, and unit and UI tests.

github_app.description_project: GitHub user search with Retrofit, favorites, and an alarm manager reminder.

kotawaringin_tourist.description_project: Tourist spots in Kotawaringin Barat, built for the Dicoding beginner Android course.
